messages.subject: shinyGUI changes
parts:
Hi Phil. I'm developing a CAT with the mirtCAT package and I would like to know if is possible to do some modifications in mirtCAT's shinyGUI, as below: 
  

1)        Modificate the “lastpage” to show the user’s results, like summary of the mirtCAT, straight at the shiny without the need to return to R and run the proper 
         commands. 

2)        After finished an individual CAT, is it possible that someone else does the test without needing to run the mirtCAT function, using only the shiny’s layout? 

3)        Store the results in some way that, for an example, after 2 users, it shows the 2 results simultaneously. 

Is it possible to do some or all of these modifications with the actual mirtCAT package?

Thanks.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: shinyGUI changes
parts:
On Fri, May 15, 2015 at 11:17 AM, lucas bozza <lucas...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Phil. I'm developing a CAT with the mirtCAT package and I would like to know if is possible to do some modifications in mirtCAT's shinyGUI, as below: 
  

1)        Modificate the “lastpage” to show the user’s results, like summary of the mirtCAT, straight at the shiny without the need to return to R and run the proper 
         commands.

I'd been thinking about adding customization options for the last page to do this, but hadn't got around to it yet. IT would probably be in the form of a function input to the shinyGUI list, maybe shinyGUI = list(lastPageFun <- function(...) ), where the user could specify the output they wanted using the objects defined internally. I'll think about doing this sometime before the next major release (check the dev version for updates).
2)        After finished an individual CAT, is it possible that someone else does the test without needing to run the mirtCAT function, using only the shiny’s layout?

I'm not sure I understand why you would even want to do this. CATs are entirely parallel processes, so having a GUI session continue on seems like an awkward idea. Perhaps have a master.R source file and run multiple instances of mirtCAT(), which will open a new GUI session in a different browser tab when the previous CAT is completed.
3)        Store the results in some way that, for an example, after 2 users, it shows the 2 results simultaneously.

Relates to 1). When I've added this feature, you could use a read.___ function to read in previously saved results and print them as you like. But again, I have to get around to actually writing that. Cheers.

Phil

Is it possible to do some or all of these modifications with the actual mirtCAT package?

Thanks.
